t: This is the bust of Thomas Baker, a marble portrait carved in 1638 and now in the Victoria and Albert Museum. It is credited to Gian Lorenzo Bernini, though much of the work was done by one of his pupils, probably Andrea Bolgi. The museum bought it in 1921 for 1480 guineas. Bernini was an Italian sculptor, architect and painter, and the leading sculptor of his age, credited with creating the Baroque style of sculpture.
